notes.title: 🆕 V0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]The V0.6 update introduces a new feature and several important bug fixes:[/p][h3]✨ New Feature[/h3][list][*][p][b]Crosshair Cursor Smoothing[/b]: When using external light gun hardware, the crosshair could jitter due to excessive sensitivity. A smoothing system has now been added to improve stability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smoothing Adjustment[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Press [b],[/b] to increase smoothing for more stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Press [b].[/b] to decrease smoothing for higher precision when using a mouse.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]spiders could get stuck at the cave exit respawn point[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the [b]reload sound could not be stopped[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]some fonts were not displaying correctly[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p]

[h2]🛠 Update Notes | Patch Released[/h2][p]Agents, thank you for your support and feedback!
We’ve just rolled out a small update that addresses the following issues:[/p][list][*][p]🌐 [b]Language Setting Fix[/b]: The game now correctly detects and uses your default language.[/p][/*][*][p]🏆 [b]Achievement Fix[/b]: Resolved an issue where certain achievements could not be unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]🐛 [b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]: Fixed several minor bugs and improved overall stability.[/p][/*][/list][p]Please keep sharing your feedback in the community — we’ll continue polishing the game to bring you a better experience![/p]

notes.title: 🎯Demo Official Guide – BloodStorm: AlienPurge
notes.content:
[h1]🎯 Demo Official Guide – BloodStorm: AlienPurge[/h1][hr][/hr][h2]📖 Basic Controls[/h2][list][*][p][b]Pistol[/b]
    [list][*][p]Single-shot, fast reload speed
    [/p][/*][*][p]Magazine: 8 rounds
    [/p][/*][*][p]Ammo Reserve: Unlimited
    [/p][/*][*][p]✨ Main weapon throughout the game; skilled players can clear the game using only the pistol.
    [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][*][p][b]Rifle[/b]
    [list][*][p]Automatic fire, high DPS
    [/p][/*][*][p]Magazine: 30 rounds
    [/p][/*][*][p]Ammo must be collected during gameplay
    [/p][/*][*][p]⚡ Slower reload; recommended for heavy battles and boss fights.
    [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][/list][p][img src=""][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🧩 Core Gameplay Mechanics[/h2][h3]🎯 Weak Spot System[/h3][list][*][p]Each monster has a designated [b]weak point[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p]Hitting the weak spot [b]deals double damage and doubles your score[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p]Example: Big-Eyed Monsters' weak point is their eyeball, but they [i]frequently blink[/i] to protect it. Different variants blink differently.
[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚡ Attack Wind-up and Stagger Mechanics[/h3][list][*][p]Most monsters have a clear [b]attack wind-up animation[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p]Stronger monsters have [b]shorter wind-ups[/b], requiring faster reactions.
[/p][/*][*][p]Tip: [i]Interrupt or kill[/i] enemies before their attack completes!
[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔥 QTE Dodge System[/h3][list][*][p]Floating targets labeled [b]L1, L2, R1, R2[/b] appear during combat.
[/p][/*][*][p]Shoot the correct sequence according to:
    [list][*][p]Enemy attack direction
    [/p][/*][*][p]Your current position (e.g., avoid dodging toward walls)
    [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][*][p]Mistakes will cause [b]HP loss[/b] or [b]instant defeat[/b].
[/p][/*][/list][h3]🕵️ Stay Sharp: Observation, Judgment, Reaction[/h3][list][*][p]Observe enemy spawn locations and movements carefully.
[/p][/*][*][p]Manage ammo wisely — [b]do not blindly empty your magazine[/b].
[/p][/*][*][p]Prioritize interrupting enemies about to attack.
[/p][/*][*][p]Mastering this means you can [b]clear the game with the pistol only[/b]!
[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]👾 Demo Version – Monster Overview[/h2][list][*][p][b]Big-Eyed Scythe Soldier[/b]
    [list][*][p]Low HP
    [/p][/*][*][p]Close-range attacks
    [/p][/*][*][p]Long attack wind-up
    [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][*][p][b]Big-Eyed Axe Thrower[/b]
    [list][*][p]Low HP
    [/p][/*][*][p]Throws axes at moderate speed
    [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][*][p][b]Big-Eyed Barrel Thrower[/b]
    [list][*][p]Throws explosive barrels
    [/p][/*][*][p]Massive damage if barrels are not destroyed mid-air
    [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][*][p][b]Big-Eyed Shuriken Thrower[/b]
    [list][*][p]Throws fast-moving shuriken
    [/p][/*][*][p]Easier to destroy than axes, but much faster
    [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][*][p][b]Big-Eyed Spearman[/b]
    [list][*][p]Fast charge attacks
    [/p][/*][*][p]Short attack wind-up
    [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ironclad Big-Eyed Boss[/b]
    [list][*][p]Heavy armor + giant iron axe
    [/p][/*][*][p]Can one-shot kill the player
    [/p][/*][*][p]Must break its armor to stagger it
    [/p][/*][*][p]Summons other enemy types during battle
    [/p][/*][/list][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]📢 Final Reminder[/h2][list][*][p]Stay calm, observe enemy patterns.
[/p][/*][*][p]Always manage your ammo and reloads strategically.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Remember: True agents rely not just on firepower, but on superior intelligence and reflexes![/b]
[/p][/*][/list]
